questions.question: If an ability allows me to re-roll one dice from an XD6 roll (e.g. the Blades of the Hollow King 'Aurelias' ability), could I then use a different ability to re-roll the entire XD6 roll?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: How should I resolve an ability that refers to an enemy's Control characteristic (e.g. Ushoran's 'Shroudcage Fragment') if the target does not have a Control characteristic (e.g. a manifestation)?
questions.answer: The target is treated as having a Control characteristic of 0.

questions.question: Some abilities (e.g. 'All-out Attack') have a red timing bar. Can these abilities only be used in the combat phase?
questions.answer: No. The words in the timing bar or, in the case of reactions and passive abilities, the specific wording of the ability will let you know exactly when you can use it; the colour is just there as a play aid. If a phase is not specified, the colour indicates the most common phase it is used in or, if it is used in multiple phases equally, the timing bar is black.

questions.question: Some abilities have a green timing bar. What does this mean?
questions.answer: The green timing bar is used to indicate defensive abilities, many of which can be used in multiple phases.

questions.question: Are non-passive abilities such as 'Burning Wyrdflame' optional to use?
questions.answer: Yes. You must apply the effects of passive abilities and abilities that state that they must be used if it is possible to do so, but all other abilities are optional to use.

questions.question: In 'Pick a friendly non-Hero Legion of the First Prince Daemon Infantry or Cavalry unit that has been destroyed to be the target' (and similar wordings with multiple keywords), does 'Cavalry unit' mean just that (i.e. with no other keywords) or does it mean 'friendly non-Hero Legion of the First Prince Daemon Cavalry unit'?
questions.answer: It means 'friendly non-Hero Legion of the First Prince Daemon Cavalry unit'.

questions.question: Where an ability references multiple keywords but has 'non-' at the start of the sequence of keywords (for example, the Skaven Brood Terror's Lend a Claw ability which targets 'non-Skryre Moulder' units'), does this mean the target must not have any of the keywords listed (in this example, the target couldn't have Skryre or Moulder keywords), or does it mean the target cannot have the first keyword but must have the second (in this example, it cannot have Skryre but must have Moulder)?
questions.answer: The 'non-' only relates to the keyword it is directly attached to. Therefore, in the example given, the target cannot have the Skryre keyword but must have the Moulder keyword. If the intent were to exclude both keywords, then it would be expressed as 'non-Skryre non-Moulder'.

questions.question: When resolving the effect of an ability that refers to a Save characteristic of 3+ or better (e.g. the 'Cloying Quagmire' spell), what does 'or better' mean?
questions.answer: It means any Save characteristic with a lower value than 3+, such as 2+, that better protects against incoming damage.

questions.question: If an ability allows another friendly unit to be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after a friendly unit has used a Fight ability (for example, the Crypt Haunter Courtier's 'Knightly Exemplar' ability), does the second unit being activated have to meet the requirements of the declare step of the Fight ability it is using?
questions.answer: Yes. So, for example, if the second unit being activated was using the 'Fight' ability, it would need to be in combat or have charged in the same turn.

questions.question: If an ability references a qualifier that multiple objects are tied for (e.g. two terrain features are equally close to an Awakened Wyldwood that is using the 'Ever Growing' ability), what happens?
questions.answer: The player who used the ability chooses which object to affect.

questions.question: Are reaction abilities subject to the Rules of One? For example, if a unit has a reaction ability on their warscroll, could they only use it once per phase?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If a non-Fly Infantry Hero (e.g. a Scinari Cathallar) is a Shrine Guardian of a Shrine Luminor, and that Shrine Guardian is within 1" of an obscuring terrain feature, is the Shrine Guardian visible to enemy abilities that target the Shrine Guardian?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If a model in base-to-base contact with an enemy model retreats 3" directly away from the enemy model, is it still in combat with that enemy model?
questions.answer: No.

rules.title: 9.1.1 SETTING UP OBJECTIVES AND TERRAIN FEATURES

questions.question: If a battleplan instructs you to set up an objective on a corner of the battlefield, should you place the entire 40mm objective marker on the battlefield, or should the centre of the objective marker be on the corner?
questions.answer: The centre of the objective marker should be on the corner.

questions.question: If a rule requires that a unit be 'outside of friendly territory' or 'wholly outside of friendly territory', would a unit that is not on the battlefield (for example a destroyed unit or a unit in reserve) count?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Can you choose to deploy units that are in a regiment using the 'Deploy Unit' ability instead of 'Deploy Regiment'?
questions.answer: Yes. However, once a unit in a regiment has been deployed in this manner, you can no longer use 'Deploy Regiment' to deploy the remaining units in that regiment, since the declare step of that ability specifies that 'No units in that regiment can have already been deployed.'

questions.question: Is it mandatory for players to set up a faction terrain feature (if one is included on their roster) during the deployment phase?
questions.answer: No. A player can choose not to use the 'Deploy Faction Terrain' ability. However, if both players choose to set up a faction terrain feature, the player who begins deployment must set up their faction terrain features first (as specified in Step 1 of 10.0).

questions.question: When determining the active player, how do you determine when a player has 'finished setting up their army'?
questions.answer: A player has finished setting up their army when all units in their army have been deployed. This means that non-Deploy Deployment Phase abilities (e.g. The Masque's 'The Endless Dance' ability) happen after your army has 'finished setting up'.

questions.question: When using the 'Charge' ability, does my unit need to end the charge move within 1/2" of an enemy unit that was visible to the charging unit at the start of that charge move?
questions.answer: No. It must end the charge move within 1/2" of an enemy unit that is visible to the charging unit when it finishes that charge move.

questions.question: If an ability adds or subtracts to the number of dice that make up a charge roll, is that a modifier to the charge roll?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: The rules for moving across terrain state that a model cannot end a move mid-climb. How can you tell if a model is mid-climb?
questions.answer: A model is mid-climb if it is not possible to rest it on its base in that location without additional support. As there is a wide variety of terrain and models, it is acceptable for a model to end a move with its base at a slight angle because of uneven terrain beneath it, but at least half of its base must be within 1" of the terrain feature that the model is on or it will be considered mid-climb.

questions.question: If an ability that allows a unit to move states that the unit cannot move into combat (e.g. Normal Move), does Fly allow that unit to move across an enemy unit's combat range?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: When making shooting attacks, can all models in the attacking unit shoot even if the target unit is not visible to some of those models?
questions.answer: No, the only models in the attacking unit that can make shooting attacks are those that the target unit is visible to.

questions.question: When a unit uses a Shoot ability, does it have to shoot with all of the ranged weapons that it is armed with?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If an ability allows a unit to score critical hits on unmodified rolls of 5+, but that unit needs a 6 to hit (e.g. as a result of subtracting 1 from hit rolls), would unmodified hit rolls of 5 hit the target? If so, would they still trigger any critical hit effects?
questions.answer: Although the hits would count as critical hits, the attacks would not score a successful hit. As the attack sequence ends if an attack fails, effects such as Crit (2 Hits) or Crit (Auto-wound) would have no effect. However, effects that are resolved immediately, such as Crit (Mortal), would still be triggered by those critical hits.

questions.question: If a unit is affected by two different abilities (such as the Ashen Elder's 'Stoked Fanaticism' and the Taar's Grand Forgehost spell 'Reinforce Daemonsteel') that would let it ignore the first damage in a phase, will it ignore the first and second damage points in that phase? If a unit takes damage in a phase before being affected by an ability that would let it ignore the first damage in a phase (e.g. by killing models that brought it wholly within such an effect), will it ignore the next damage point it would take that phase?
questions.answer: No and no. It will only ever ignore the first damage point that was dealt to that unit in that phase.

questions.question: Do models removed as a result of a unit being out of coherency count as having been slain?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Can I use an ability that allows a friendly unit that does not have Strike-first to fight immediately after a friendly unit that has Strike-first if there are one or more enemy units with Strike-first that have not yet been picked to fight?
questions.answer: No. As mentioned in the sidebar next to 19.0, abilities that allow a unit to use a Fight ability immediately after another unit do not override the Strike-first constraints, so you cannot pick a unit that does not have Strike-first to fight until all other units that have Strike-first have fought.

questions.question: If a friendly unit is the only unit that has Strike-first on the battlefield and it has an ability that allows a friendly unit to fight immediately after it, in what order would units be picked to fight?
questions.answer: If you are the active player, the unit that has Strike-first would fight first, then you could use the ability to allow another friendly unit to fight immediately after it, and then you would pick the next unit to fight (i.e. three friendly units would fight back to back). If your opponent is the active player, the unit that has Strike-first would fight first, you could still use the ability to allow another friendly unit to fight, and then your opponent would pick the next unit to fight.

questions.question: In the combat phase, if all eligible non-Strike-last units have used a Fight ability, which player gets to pick the first Strike- last unit to fight?
questions.answer: The alternating sequence of picking units to use a Fight ability would continue and so the player who did not pick the last non- Strike-last unit would get to pick the first eligible Strike-last unit in their army to use a Fight ability.

questions.question: Can I combine multiple instances of the same weapon ability? For example, if a weapon already has Anti-Infantry (+1 Rend) and it can also gain that ability from another source, would it now have +2 Rend against Infantry units?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: If a weapon has the Companion weapon ability, would it be affected by friendly abilities that grant new weapon abilities or that modify weapon abilities that the weapon already has?
questions.answer: No, unless the ability specifically names the weapon or states that it affects Companion weapons.

questions.question: If an ability (e.g. 'Seed of Rebirth') would allow a unit that would be destroyed to negate all remaining damage points then heal to prevent that unit from being destroyed, and another ability (e.g. 'Quenching the Flames') prevents that unit from healing, would that unit still be destroyed?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Can a unit use a Move ability and then be affected by an ability which removes them from the battlefield and sets them up again in the same movement phase? For example, could a friendly non-Monster Stormcast Eternals unit move to be wholly within 6" of a Stormreach Portal, and then in the same movement phase use the 'Step Into the Storm' ability?
questions.answer: Yes. Units cannot use Move abilities in the movement phase after being set up on the battlefield that turn, but are able to use Move abilities before doing so.

questions.question: If a destroyed unit had an enhancement, and an ability allows me to set up a replacement of that unit, would the replacement unit also have that enhancement?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: If an ability allows a replacement unit to be set up with half the models from the original unit, and the original unit has to have a certain proportion of models equipped with specific weapons, does the new unit also need to adhere to the same restrictions?
questions.answer: No. As stated in 24.2, you can pick any models from the original unit to be set up in the replacement unit.

questions.question: If an ability allows a replacement unit to be set up with half the models from the original unit, could I then use an ability such as 'Rally' to return models to that unit until it reached the unit size of the original unit?
questions.answer: No. A replacement unit is treated as a new unit with a new unit size.

questions.question: If an ability allows me to ignore the effects of the 'Guarded Hero' ability when picking targets (e.g. the Warlock Engineer's 'Sniper- master' ability), would the attacking unit still be affected by the -1 to hit penalty from 'Guarded Hero'?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Do you roll a random characteristic roll before or after declaring a Run ability?
questions.answer: After declaring it and after all reactions are used.

questions.question: If a rule says to pick a number of units with one keyword or another (e.g. 'Pick up to 3 friendly Skink Infantry or Cavalry units'), could you pick a combination of units with either keyword, or do all the units you pick need to have the same keyword?
questions.answer: You can mix and match. In the example given, you could pick 1 Skink Infantry unit and 2 Skink Cavalry units.

questions.question: If a persisting effect applies to a unit that is destroyed, and another ability allows that unit to return to the battlefield (e.g. the 'Resurrection' prayer from the Path to Glory: Ascension battlepack), does the persisting effect apply to the returned unit?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If a part of an ability's effect does not state that you 'can' or 'must' do it, is it mandatory to resolve that part of the effect?
questions.answer: Yes. Any part of an effect that is not optional is mandatory. If you cannot resolve one part of an effect, none of it applies. For instance, if a player picked the Wizard casting 'The Hand of Gork' to also be the target of the spell, the effect could not be fully resolved  it would be impossible for the target to be removed from the battlefield and set up again wholly within 24" of the caster  and so the spell would have no effect.

questions.question: Do persisting effects continue to apply to a unit that has been destroyed?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If an ability that is not on a unit's warscroll has the 'Once Per Turn', 'Once Per Battle' or 'Once Per Battle Round' timing (without '(Army)' afterwards), can multiple friendly units use that ability in that time period?
questions.answer: It depends on who is using the ability (see the sidebar next to 28.2). If a unit is using the ability (i.e. the declare step specifically says to pick a unit to use it), then each unit could use that ability in that time period. If the player is using the ability (i.e. nothing in the ability specifically says that it is used by a unit), it can only be used once in that time period. Note that picking the target of an ability is not the same as picking a unit to use that ability.

questions.question: If a player controls a piece of terrain, can a unit be counted towards contesting a different piece of terrain while still maintaining control of the first piece?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If an ability modifies a run roll, does that ability modify the roll made in the 'Redeploy' ability, since 'Redeploy' has the Run keyword?
questions.answer: No, named rolls such as run roll are only modified by abilities that specifically call out that type of roll.

questions.question: If a friendly unit is in combat and is armed with a weapon that has Shoot in Combat, can it use the 'Covering Fire' command?
questions.answer: No, you can only pick units that are not in combat to use that ability.

questions.question: If a unit cannot be picked to be the target of shooting attacks (e.g. an Infantry Hero affected by the 'Guarded Hero' ability) but is the closest unit to a friendly unit using the 'Covering Fire' command, do I still have to target that unit?
questions.answer: No, you must pick the nearest eligible unit that can be picked to be the target of shooting attacks.

questions.question: If a faction terrain feature is closer to a friendly unit using the 'Covering Fire' command than any other units, do I have to target that faction terrain feature? Can I choose to?
questions.answer: No to both. However, some faction terrain features (such as the Shrine Luminor) allow a unit to be placed on them. Since, in these cases, you measure range and visibility to and from the terrain feature instead of the unit, you would have to target that terrain feature if it was closest.

questions.question: If a manifestation is closer to a friendly unit using the 'Covering Fire' command than any other units, do I have to target that manifestation? Can I choose to?
questions.answer: No to both.

questions.question: When using the 'Power Through' command, can my models pass through enemy models in the target unit or only through the target unit's combat range?
questions.answer: Your models can only pass through the target unit's combat range, unless your unit has Fly or is otherwise allowed to pass through models.

questions.question: Can faction terrain or manifestations be picked as the target for 'Power Through'?
questions.answer: Yes, if it has a Move characteristic greater than '-'.

questions.question: Are faction terrain features still subject to the restrictions in Core Rules, 5.3 The Rules of One?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If an ability requires you to set up a unit more than 9" from all enemy units, could you set up a unit within 9" of a faction terrain feature?
questions.answer: Yes. However, some faction terrain features (such as the Shrine Luminor) allow a unit to be placed on them. Since, in these cases, you measure range and visibility to and from the terrain feature instead of the unit, you would not be able to set up a unit within 9" of a faction terrain feature that has a unit on it.

questions.question: Are faction terrain features affected by friendly abilities (e.g. those that give units the Ward keyword)?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Can faction terrain features use command abilities?
questions.answer: No, unless that command is on the faction terrain feature's warscroll.

questions.question: If an ability or battle tactic requires a unit to be destroyed (e.g. 'The Blood Tithe'), does destroying a faction terrain feature count?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Can a unit placed on a faction terrain feature be picked as the target of enemy abilities (as opposed to the target of attacks)? For example, if I were to pick a Shrine Luminor as the target of the Realmshaper Engine's 'Power Unleashed' ability, could I pick the hero placed on the Shrine Luminor as a target of that ability?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Do I need to use a Retreat ability to move away from a faction terrain feature that has a Move characteristic of 0"?
questions.answer: No, you can use any Move ability. However, some faction terrain features (such as the Shrine Luminor) allow a unit to be placed on them. Since, in these cases, you measure range and visibility to and from the terrain feature instead of the unit, you would have to use a Retreat ability to move away from a terrain feature that has a unit on it.

questions.question: Can units in my army use the example spell and example prayer from the sidebar?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: If a unit has multiple power levels (e.g. a Hero that is both a Wizard and a Priest), and another ability modifies that unit's power level (e.g. the 'Witchbane Curse' prayer), which power level does it modify?
questions.answer: If that ability only targets Wizards or only targets Priests, it modifies the corresponding power level. If it could target either or does not specify the target, it modifies both.

questions.question: Is mortal damage inflicted by a miscast considered to be 'mortal damage inflicted by a Spell ability' for the purposes of abilities like the Tzeentch effect of the 'Marks of Chaos' ability?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Are manifestations still subject to the restrictions in Core Rules, 5.3 The Rules of One?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Are manifestations affected by friendly abilities that would normally affect units (e.g. those that give units the Ward keyword)?
questions.answer: No, except for those permitted in Magic, 7.0, and those that specifically affect manifestations (such as 'Banish Manifestation').

questions.question: Can manifestations use command abilities?
questions.answer: No, unless that command is on the manifestation's warscroll.

questions.question: If an ability or battle tactic requires a unit to be destroyed (e.g. 'The Blood Tithe'), does destroying a manifestation count?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Do I need to use a Retreat ability to move away from a manifestation that has a Move characteristic of 0"?
questions.answer: No, you can use any Move ability.

questions.question: If a manifestation has a Move characteristic that is greater than 0", can it use Move abilities in the movement phase of the same turn in which it was set up?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: If a power level 2 or higher wizard miscasts their first spell, could they still use the 'Banish Manifestation' ability in that phase?
questions.answer: Yes. Miscasting only prevents that wizard from using any more spells in that phase.

questions.question: If a manifestation has multiple parts (e.g. Geminids of Uhl-Gysh) and is in combat, can one part of the manifestation be 'in combat' while the other is not? If one part is in combat can the other part make a pile-in move?
questions.answer: If any part of a manifestation is considered to be in combat, the entire manifestation is considered to be in combat. If one part can pile in, all parts can pile in (but must all pile in towards the same enemy unit as per the rules for piling in).

questions.question: How does the Prismatic Palisade's 'Blinding Light' ability interact with picking targets for shooting attacks?
questions.answer: A model in the attacking unit can only make shooting attacks against the target unit if a straight line can be drawn from that model to any model in the target unit without that line crossing the Prismatic Palisade.

questions.question: Can manifestations use Move abilities in the movement phase of the turn they were set up?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Can 'Magical Intervention' be used to use the 'Banish Manifestation' ability after gaining the ability to use 'Banish Manifestation' from a Place of Power.
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Are manifestations affected by the 'Obscuring' terrain ability?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: When using an Army of Renown, can I pick a faction terrain feature to include on my roster?
questions.answer: Yes, unless that Army of Renown's rules specifically state that you cannot include a faction terrain feature.

questions.question: When ability A references ability B, where B is in a different ruleset from the one I am using, can I use ability B? For example, if I am playing the Big Waaagh! army of renown and I have Gordrakk in my army, can I use WAAAGH! abilities (i.e. the 'Ironjawz Waaagh!' ability) referenced by Gordrakk's 'Voice of Gork' ability?
questions.answer: No. In the example above, 'Voice of Gork' is a reaction to a Waaagh! ability, and as there are no such abilities in the Big Waaagh! faction rules, then the 'Voice of Gork' ability cannot be used in a Big Waaagh! army, and neither does it grant access to Waaagh! abilities.

questions.question: If a Hero is able to join another Hero's regiment (e.g. The Shadow Queen joining Morathi-Khaine or an Assassin joining a Dreadlord on Black Dragon), do they take the place of a non-Hero unit in that regiment?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Can I add units from other factions to my Heroes' regiments?
questions.answer: No. The only way to add units from other factions to your army is by taking an eligible Regiment of Renown.

questions.question: If a Hero's regiment options contain multiple excluded keywords (e.g. non-Beast non-Monster), can it include units in its regiment that have only one of those keywords?
questions.answer: No, it cannot include units with any of those keywords.

questions.question: Can my army include a Warmaster (e.g. Sigvald, Prince of Slaanesh) in another hero's regiment?
questions.answer: Yes, but only if your army includes another Warmaster unit, since your general must lead a regiment, and you must pick a Warmaster as your general if there are any Warmaster units in your army.

questions.question: If a Regiment of Renown includes a wizard, could that wizard cast spells from a universal manifestation lore that was picked for that army?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If a Regiment of Renown (e.g. the Coven of Thryx) includes one or more manifestations, do those manifestations replace picking a manifestation lore for my army?
questions.answer: No, they are in addition.

questions.question: Does a Regiment of Renown require a Hero to lead it?
questions.answer: No. As stated in 3.5, Regiments of Renown are pre-built regiments, so they only include the units stated in their unit summary/organisation section.

questions.question: If an ability allows a unit to gain an enhancement during a battle (for example, the Sons of Behemat 'More Stuff for me Collection' ability) and I pick an enhancement that costs points, do I need to have sufficient spare points in my army roster in order to pay for that enhancement?
questions.answer: No. Enhancements added to your army during a battle do not cost any points.

questions.question: If a rule requires more friendly models than enemy models to be contesting battle tactic 'Hold Ground'), should I use the control scores of my units
questions.answer: Yes. In these cases, the rule should be treated in the same way as determining 17 a terrain feature (e.g. the Ghyran twist 'Take the Land' or the contesting that terrain feature? control of a terrain feature (Core Rules, 32.3).

questions.question: Are relics counted as terrain features for abilities such as 'Strike and
questions.answer: No. 19 Fade'?

questions.question: Can I complete the same battle tactic multiple times in a battle?
questions.answer: No, unless specified otherwise.

questions.question: If I have met the conditions to complete a battle tactic can I choose not to complete that tactic at the end of my turn?
questions.answer: No. If the conditions are fulfilled and you have not already scored a battle tactic from that card this turn, you must score that battle tactic.

questions.question: If a unit uses 'All-out Attack' in the shooting phase and the combat phase, do I subtract 2 from save rolls for that unit?
questions.answer: No. Persisting effects (see 28.1) count as the effects of passive abilities for their duration, so units cannot be affected by the same persisting effect more than once.

questions.question: While every model in a friendly non-Monster unit is within 1" of an Obscuring terrain feature, are they visible to friendly units?
questions.answer: Yes. They are just not visible to enemy units outside of their combat range.

questions.question: When a Hero uses 'Activate Place of Power' and picks Tap the Ley Lines, can they use both the 'Unbind' ability and the 'Banish Manifestation' ability in the same phase?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: If a hero is garrisoning a faction terrain feature, can it still be picked as the target of abilities other than attacks?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Can I use Scourge of Aqshy enhancements, lores and battle formations in an Army of Renown?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: How does damage inflicted by 'Pulsing Life Energies' interact with The Shadow Queen's 'Iron Heart of Khaine' ability?
questions.answer: Since the damage is inflicted in the Start of Battle Round timing window, before either player's turn has started, 'Iron Heart of Khaine' would have no effect on those damage points. In addition, those damage points would not count towards the limit on damage allocation from 'Iron Heart of Khaine' in the next turn.

questions.question: In the Roiling Roots battleplan, if a unit that has Strike-last because it is contesting an objective that has been picked as the target of the 'Tangling Tendrils' ability, what happens if the models in that unit that are contesting that objective are slain?
questions.answer: The unit only has Strike-last while any models in that unit are contesting that objective. It loses the Strike-last effect immediately after all of the models that were contesting that objective have been slain and removed from the battlefield.

rules.title: BATTLE TACTICS CARD 3: INTERCEPT AND RECOVER

questions.question: If your opponent has picked the Intercept and Recover battle tactic card and they destroy 2 or 3 of your units that are carrying Ghyranite Treasure in the same turn, and then they choose to go first after going second in the previous battle round, can you remove a Ghyranite Treasure that has not been scored yet from a destroyed unit?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If both players have the Intercept and Recover battle tactic card, what is the order in which players pick units to be carrying Ghyranite Treasures?
questions.answer: The attacker picks all their units first, then the defender picks all their units.

questions.question: When using 'Eruption of Fury', can I use a reaction to pick another unit to use a Fight ability immediately after?
questions.answer: No  while you can use reactions to 'Eruption of Fury', abilities that let you pick a unit to immediately use a Fight ability do not override the restrictions of the Fight ability. As a result, you cannot use them to have a unit fight outside the combat phase.

questions.question: Do Strike-first or Strike-last have any effect when using 'Eruption of Fury'?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: In the Hidden Under Ash-clouds battleplan, are the ash-clouds low-lying during the deployment phase?
questions.answer: Yes, as there is no underdog during the deployment phase.

questions.question: When applying the effect of 'Fight Through the Pain', are rage dice spent one at a time or all at once?
questions.answer: All at once.

questions.question: How do manifestations and faction terrain interact with the new seasonal abilities?
questions.answer: Manifestations and faction terrain cannot use 'Eruption of Fury' or benefit from 'Fight Through the Pain', as they are not units. Enemy manifestations and faction terrain can only be targeted by 'Eruption of Fury' if they have a Move characteristic  the friendly unit will not be in combat with them in the End of Turn phase if they do not.

questions.question: In Ambuscade, for a unit to be 'more than 6" from friendly territory', can any model in that unit be within 6" of friendly territory?
questions.answer: No.

rules.title: BATTLE TACTICS CARD 6: LEGEND OF THE PARCH

questions.question: Can you score Command from the Front if a friendly Hero is in reserve?
questions.answer: No, as that Hero is not within 9" of an enemy unit.

questions.question: In the Seize the Embers battleplan, can a unit bring an emberstone nugget into reserve?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Is the Pyrofane Cult Army of Renown in White Dwarf issue 514 legal for Matched Play?
questions.answer: No, it is a Legends Army of Renown.

questions.question: Can I include Scourge of Aqshy units in an Army of Renown instead of their standard version?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Can I include Scourge of Aqshy units in a Regiment of Renown instead of their standard version?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Can more than one Scourge of Aqshy Auric Runeson on Magmadroth pick the same Auric Runefather on Magmadroth as the target of their 'Fire, Blood and Vengeance'?
questions.answer: Yes. That Runefather had a big family.

rules.title: SKAVEN, GREY SEER ON SCREAMING BELL

questions.question: If I successfully cast 'Gnaw Through Reality' on a Scourge of Aqshy Grey Seer on Screaming Bell, could I then use 'Tunnels Through Reality' to remove that unit and set it up wholly within 6" of another friendly Gnawhole?
questions.answer: No. 'Gnaw Through Reality' does not allow the Grey Seer on Screaming Bell to use abilities from the Gnawhole warscroll, only to be treated as a Gnawhole when using those abilities.

questions.question: Does 'the Health characteristic of that unit' in the effect of the 'Banner of Old Ossia' ability refer to the unit using the 'Rally' command or the unit having slain models returned to it?
questions.answer: The unit having slain models returned to it.

questions.question: Is the halved movement from the 'Lord of Space and Time' ability permanent?
questions.answer: No, it applies only in your opponent's next turn.

questions.question: Does the 'Blood-drenched' ability have any effect on Skarbrand in The Exiled One Regiment of Renown?
questions.answer: No. That ability is a Blades of Khorne battle trait and so will have no effect on a unit in a Regiment of Renown. 37

questions.question: Does Skarbrand's 'Skarbrand's Rage' ability mean that Skarbrand is affected by the 'Blood-drenched' ability in the first turn of a battle?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Does the 'Overheating' ability remove one heat token or one heat token for each 5+?
questions.answer: One heat token for each 5+. 39

questions.question: If a Lord of Change's 'Temporal Manipulation' spell is measured from an Argent Shard due to the 'Magical Focus' ability, does the target of that spell have to end their move nearer to the Lord of Change or the Argent Shard?
questions.answer: The Lord of Change. The Argent Shard's 'Magical Focus' ability only affects the picking of targets.

questions.question: What happens to a persistent effect that is applied to unit if that unit is removed from the battlefield during the battle and set in reserve? For example, if a Disciples of Tzeentch unit that has had the 'Shield of Fate' spell cast on them is set up in reserve using the 'Smoke and Mirrors' ability?
questions.answer: The persistent effect would remain applied for the respective timing of that ability. In the example, the Disciples of Tzeentch unit would still have the effect of 'Shield of Fate' if it was later re-set up on the battlefield before its commanding player's next hero phase.

questions.question: If a unit of Jade Obelisk is placed into reserve or destroyed, does the effect of 'Chosen by the Stone' continue to apply to the enemy unit that its Idolarc is next to?
questions.answer: Yes, it is a persisting effect.

questions.question: When the target of 'Glimpse of Delusion' makes combat attacks as a result of the effect of that spell, can the 'All-out Attack' command or the 'All-out Defence' command be used as reactions to those attacks?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: If a Maggotkin of Nurgle unit is picked as the target of Ushoran's 'Glimpse of Delusion' ability and resolving that ability results in a model in that unit being slain, would that trigger the 'Vectors of Contagion' ability on that Maggotkin of Nurgle unit?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Does the 'Delusions and Madness' ability of the Charnel Watch Spearhead army allow me to pick the Delusion regiment ability that I did not pick at the start of the battle?
questions.answer: No. You can pick from the Delusion regiment ability that you picked at the start of the battle, 'Delusion of the Great Feast' or 'Delusion of the Knightly Host'.

questions.question: When using the Lunar Squigs effect of 'Under the Light of the Bad Moon' or the 'The Moon and the Loon' ability to use a value of 4 for the Move characteristic of a friendly Squig unit, does the 4 replace the entire Move characteristic of the unit with a 4, or just the dice roll?
questions.answer: It replaces the dice roll. For example, if a unit of Squig Hoppers (with a Move characteristic of D6+8") were affected by one of these abilities, it could use a value of 4 instead of rolling the D6, resulting in a Move characteristic of 12" (4+8").

questions.question: Can the attacker choose to resolve their attacks one at a time for the Doom Diver Catapult? If so, how does the Rend reduction apply?
questions.answer: Yes. As described in the rules for the attack sequence (17.0), attacks are resolved one at a time unless you choose to use fast dice rolling. Here's an example attack sequence for the Doom Diver Catapult: 1. The Gloomspite Gitz player successfully hits and wounds for the first attack, then their opponent makes a save roll, subtracting the Rend (3) of the weapon from the roll. 2. The Gloomspite Gitz player fails the hit roll for the second attack, re-rolls it to be successful and successfully wounds. Then, their opponent makes a save roll subtracting the now-reduced Rend (2) from the roll. 3. The third attack fails to hit and fails again after the re-roll. The Rend is now reduced to 1. 4. The fourth attacks successfully hits and wounds. The opponent of the Gloomspite Gitz player subtracts the Rend (1) from their save roll.

questions.question: When using 'Harness Daemonic Power', when daemonic power points are removed from units, are they retained to be reallocated to friendly units or are they lost?
questions.answer: They are lost.

questions.question: If one of the War Machines in the Curse-Steel Battery has been destroyed, can the 'Display of Total Power' ability be used?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: When a unit in a Taar's Grand Forgehost army gains a daemonic power point (for example, from the Infernal Cohort with Hashutite Spears' 'Conquered Lands' ability), does it lose that daemonic power point at the end of the battle round?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Is a unit that is picked to be the target of an Akhelian Allopex's 'Ensnared' ability ensnared for the purposes of the Abyssal Tendril's 'Watery Clutch' and 'Crushing Coil' abilities?
questions.answer: No. 52

questions.question: Is an Abyssal Tendril a separate manifestation to the Incarnate of the Deep and other Abyssal Tendrils?
questions.answer: Yes, and each Abyssal Tendril adds 1 to an opponent's banishment roll.

questions.question: Can an Arkanaut Frigate use the 'Assault Boat' ability if it used a Run ability in the same turn but was picked as a target of Brokk Grungsson's 'Command the Fleet' ability earlier in the same turn?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Can I use the 'Assault Boat' ability in combination with 'Counter-charge'?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If I use the 'Blazebeard and Sons Bamboozling Flakgun' artefact of power to remove a dice from my opponent's charge roll, and then my opponent uses the 'Forward to Victory' command, how many dice does my opponent re-roll for that charge roll?
questions.answer: They would roll the number of dice left in the charge roll after 1 dice has been removed. For example, if the original charge roll was made with 2 dice and 1 of those dice was removed by the Blazebeard and Sons Bamboozling Flakgun, your opponent would re-roll that 1 remaining dice to determine their re-rolled charge roll.

questions.question: When I depict Varinor, Rune of Strength on my battle scripture, are the bonuses to run rolls and charge rolls based on the number of targets? For instance, if I have 2 depictions of Varinor on my battle scripture, and I pick 4 targets, do they each get +4 to run rolls and +4 to charge rolls?
questions.answer: No. Add 1 to run rolls and add 1 to charge rolls for each target.

questions.question: Can I make an unbinding roll before deciding whether to use the 'Release Arcane Charge' ability?
questions.answer: Only if the unbinding roll is in the declare step of the ability being reacted to. If the unbinding roll is in the effect step, for example in the 'Unbind' ability, you must declare that you are using the 'Release Arcane Charge' ability before making the unbinding roll.

questions.question: 1) If Lyrior Uthralle has Strike-first (e.g. from the 'Focused Fury' ability) and I am using the Warhost of Duality battle formation, can I pick another unit to use a Fight ability immediately after Lyrior has used a Fight ability because of the 'Strike as One' ability? And 2) If there are no other units with Strike-first and it is my turn to pick the first unit to fight in the combat phase, can I then pick 2 other eligible friendly units to use a Fight ability?
questions.answer: 1) Yes, as long as there are no other units that have Strike-first, or if the second unit picked to use a Fight ability also has Strike-first. 2) Yes.

questions.question: If a unit within 3" of a plague progenitor picked as the target of the 'Spread' effect of the 'Blessed by the Plaguefather' ability has the Disease keyword, would D3 mortal damage still be inflicted upon it from that 'Plague Progenitor' effect?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If a plague progenitor would heal in the first battle round, can it remove disease instead?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Does the 'Desperate Remedies' ability remove the Diseased keyword from an undamaged unit?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: When using the 'Contagious Catarrh' ability, can you pick 0 Mire Kelpies?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If you have picked 1 or more Mire Kelpies when using the 'Contagious Catarrh' ability and roll a 1, are those Mire Kelpies removed from the unit?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: When resolving the 'Wracked with Disease' ability and a diseased enemy unit would be destroyed by the mortal damage inflicted by that ability, triggering the effect of the 'Burst Pustules' ability, do I finish resolving the effects of 'Wracked with Disease' before resolving the effects of 'Burst Pustules'?
questions.answer: Yes, as model removal occurs after an ability has been resolved.

questions.question: Can Diseased units that are in reserve (for example if they have been placed in reserve from the battlefield by the Disciples of Tzeentch 'Smoke and Mirrors' ability) be picked as a target of the 'Wracked with Disease' ability?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: When using the 'Notorious Bosses' ability, can I give a target a heroic trait that another unit already has?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Can each part of the Foot of Gork use the 'Wandering Destruction' ability each turn?
questions.answer: No. This is a single manifestation with multiple parts, so it can only use that ability once in each turn.

questions.question: In the 'Ironjawz Bigmob' Spearhead army, are the Brute Ragerz set up during the deployment phase?
questions.answer: Yes. Only the Brutes are not set up on the battlefield during the deployment phase. The Brute Ragerz are a different unit type, so are set up normally.

questions.question: Is damage inflicted on a unit that finished a move within 6" of a trampled by Gork terrain feature damage inflicted by a Prayer ability?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Can the target of Vokmortian's 'Voice of Nagash' ability be affected by passive non-Core abilities?
questions.answer: Yes. A target of 'Voice of Nagash' will still be affected by passive non-Core abilities. In addition, it can be picked as the target of and affected by non-Core abilities used by Manifestations, terrain, the unit itself or a player. The target could not be picked as the target of or affected by non-Core abilities that affect it for the rest of the turn, and any persisting effects from a non-Core ability that are already affecting the target will temporarily cease to have an effect on it.

questions.question: If a unit of Mortek Triaxes doesn't have any Balefire Braziers next to it, can it use the 'Cursed Flames' ability?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: What happens to a friendly Balefire Brazier that is next to an enemy unit when that enemy unit is destroyed?
questions.answer: The Balefire Brazier is removed from the battlefield and is no longer used in the battle.

questions.question: When a Mortis Reapers unit uses its 'Necrocaches' ability but a 1 is rolled on the D3 for the mortal damage, can it still move 6"?
questions.answer: Yes, because in the 'Necrocaches' ability, the damage and the move are separate parts of the effect.

questions.question: Can Mortis Reapers use their 'Necrocaches' ability if they are not in combat?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Can enemy manifestations and faction terrain features be set up within the range of the 'Deathly Aura' ability?
questions.answer: No. Manifestations and faction terrain are affected by enemy abilities as if they were units.

questions.question: If I pick a friendly Stormfiends unit as the target of the 'Filth-crust' prayer with a chanting roll of 8+, how would the Crit (Mortal) weapon ability interact with the 'Shock Gauntlets' ability?
questions.answer: The Crit (Mortal) weapon ability would inflict mortal damage on the target unit equal to the Damage characteristic and the attack sequence would end, so 'Shock Gauntlets' would have no further effect.

questions.question: If an enemy unit is affected by the 'Gaze of the Gnaw' ability and must attack Vizzik Skour, can the models in that unit that are not within Vizzik Skour's combat range after piling in attack?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: If a Warp-Grinder picks another Warp-Grinder unit to be set up in the tunnels below using the 'Tunnel Skulkers' ability, can both of those units use the 'Warp-Ambush' ability to attempt to set up the units on the battlefield?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: When using the Grey Seer's 'Warpstone Shards' ability, if the 3D6 casting roll includes 2 or more rolls of 1 (before removing one of the dice), is that spell miscast?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If a flying unit passes across a Gnawhole, does it ignore the effect of the 'Volatile Ground' ability since the 'Fly' ability means that units ignore terrain features while moving?
questions.answer: No. The unit still counts as having passed across the Gnawhole, so the effect applies.

questions.question: Can a Mutated Menagerie Hell Pit Abomination that is picked as the target of the 'Rampaging Demise' ability avoid being destroyed if I roll a 5 or 6 on the 'Too Horrible To Die' ability?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: When using the 'Dark Apotheosis' ability to set up a Daemon Prince, does that Daemon Prince have to be included on my army roster and do I need to spend points on it?
questions.answer: No to both.

questions.question: If Archaon the Everchosen uses the 'Eye of Sheerian' ability and, as a result, the Slaves to Darkness player has to take the first turn in a battle round after taking the second turn in the previous battle round (i.e., they end up taking a 'double turn'), does the Slaves to Darkness player suffer the penalties for taking a 'double turn', for instance not being able to pick a battle tactic or their opponent counting as the underdog for the rest of the battle?
questions.answer: No. The penalties for taking a double turn only apply if you 'chose' to go first in the current battle round.

questions.question: Can a unit use the 'Pledge to Chaos' ability while it is not on the battlefield, e.g. if it is set up in reserve in a Silver Tower?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Can a Gaunt Summoner use the 'Minions of the Silver Tower' ability more than once to set up multiple units in a Silver Tower?
questions.answer: No, as stated in Core Rules, 5.3.

questions.question: Can I include more than 1 Ensorcelled Banner in my Slaves to Darkness army?
questions.answer: No. Ensorcelled Banners are enhancements, and as stated in Army Composition, 4.1, you can only take 1 enhancement from each enhancement table in your faction rules.

questions.question: Can Regiments of Renown be included in a Legion of the First Prince army?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Can a Daemon Prince from the Godmarked Ascendant Regiment of Renown be given enhancements?
questions.answer: Yes. In Army Composition 3.5 it states that a unit cannot use faction rules (including enhancements) unless they have a keyword that matches up with the faction's name. Since the Godmarked Ascendant Regiment of Renown adds such a keyword, that unit is eligible to be given enhancements.

questions.question: When using the General's Handbook 2026-27 battlepack, in the effect of 'For the Glory of the Dark Gods', does the applied effect change when the player's fury level does, or is it determined at the time the ability is used?
questions.answer: It changes alongside the player's fury level.

questions.question: Can I use the 'Ruination Chamber' ability to react to enemy abilities that target a friendly unit with that ability if that ability takes place outside of the regular turn sequence (e.g. a Deployment Phase ability)?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: If I use the 'Ruination Chamber' ability to react to an ability that targets multiple units and/or has multiple effects (e.g. 'Power Through'), and the roll is successful, should my opponent still resolve the parts of the ability that affect other units?
questions.answer: Yes. The 'Ruination Chamber' ability only allows you to ignore the effect of that ability on that unit; it does not stop the effect from being resolved for other units.

questions.question: What units can be replaced with Alarielle's 'The Goddess of Life' ability?
questions.answer: Only Alarielle.

questions.question: How many models are in a Kurnoth Hunters unit that has been replaced using the 'Awaken Slumbering Spirits' ability?
questions.answer: One.

questions.question: When using the 'Fury of the Forest' ability, can you pick a friendly unit that is in combat with an enemy unit and an enemy manifestation or faction terrain?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Does a Soulpod Grove terrain feature in the Soulpod Guardians Army of Renown still count as an Awakened Wyldwood?
questions.answer: Yes. It uses the Awakened Wyldwood warscroll and counts as a single Awakened Wyldwood for abilities.

questions.question: Is a unit considered to be wholly within the creeping overgrowth if it is not wholly within the range of a single terrain feature with an overgrown token, but it is wholly within overlapping ranges of multiple different terrain features with overgrown tokens?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: When building my Path to Glory roster, I can include regiments with units from different factions that are from the same grand alliance as my general. When I do so, can I use the battle traits or enhancements from that other faction?
questions.answer: No, you can only use battle traits and enhancements from the faction that you picked for your Path to Glory army or from the universal enhancements included in Path to Glory: Ravaged Coast.

questions.question: Can I add spells or prayers from a manifestation lore to my Arcane Tome when first creating my army roster?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Can I add spells from one of the universal manifestation lores (such as Forbidden Power) to my Arcane Tome?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: Do you have to include faction terrain (e.g. Gnawholes or awakened Wyldwoods) as part of your roster to use abilities that place them on the battlefield (i.e. 'Splinters of the Vermindoom' or 'Treesong')?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Do battle formations, enhancements and lores cost points?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Does the 'Headshot' ability of the Vanguard-Raptors with Longstrike Crossbows allow that unit to ignore the effect of the 'Protect at all Costs' ability on the Twisted by Rage battleplan?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: Can an army use a battle trait (such as 'Treesong' or 'Splinters of the Vermindoom') or an ability on a warscroll of a unit in their army during a battle to set up a faction terrain feature that is not on their roster?
questions.answer: Yes.

questions.question: When creating your initial 1000-point roster, do you have to pay for individual Spell, Prayer or Summon abilities if the associated lore has a points cost?
questions.answer: No. 77

questions.question: During deployment, can you deploy both a regular faction terrain feature and a Landmark of Ghyran or just one of them?
questions.answer: You can deploy both.
